notes: Browser-navigation exemplar: RealBrowserMonitorType.check() validates only url.protocol (http/https, the GHSA-2qgm LFI fix) then calls page.goto(monitor.url) with headless Chromium; redirects are followed inside the browser with no re-validation and the screenshot lands in the served screenshots directory. Verified live at the pinned SHA with a loopback PoC (direct + cross-origin redirect hop both fetch the internal marker). Deterministic G1 at :260 (scheme-only guard) and G6 at :264 (page.goto). The G8 site is isAllowedChromeExecutable's env bypass shape. webhook.js carries the notification-webhook G6 shape: axios.post(notification.webhookURL) with default redirect-follow and no host check; notification payloads can carry API keys (G10-adjacent). Prior art is per-provider: Matrix provider SSRF advisory (issue #6916); no shared URL guard exists.
